notes: The account user of the Wazuh indexer, which step 1 runs as (kubernetes/apps/security/wazuh/README.md, 'Accounts'). The owner, or the session the owner names for it, makes it once with admin through the Security API, because it grants access; the password of admin is read from its Secret into the call and is never shown or stored outside it: a PUT of the user with the hash of its password, and a PUT of the role mapping of the reserved role security_rest_api_access with the user (the image has no mapping for that role; if one exists, the user is added to its users and the others stay). This file holds no hash and no password. Step 1 never reads it, and never touches this user.
Its name is the key username of the Secret wazuh-accounts-user, and its password the key password. It carries no mark of step 1.
